definitions.gloss: defense, advocacy, speaking in someone's defense
definitions.explanation: The act of defending or speaking on behalf of someone, either in a legal setting or in everyday situations.

examples.japanese: {弁護士|べんごし}が{被告|ひこく}を{弁護|べんご}した。
{友達|ともだち}が{批判|ひはん}されたとき、{誰|だれ}も{弁護|べんご}してくれなかった。
examples.english: When my friend was criticized, nobody came to their defense.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a する verb: {弁護|べんご}する (to defend, to advocate for). Can refer to legal defense or everyday defense of someone's character or actions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弁護|べんご}する: to defend, to advocate for
- {弁護士|べんごし}: lawyer, attorney
- {弁護|べんご}{団|だん}: defense team
- {弁護|べんご}{側|がわ}: the defense (side)
- {国選|こくせん}{弁護人|べんごにん}: court-appointed defense attorney

RELATED WORDS:
{弁護士|べんごし} (lawyer) is one of the most commonly known compounds using this word.
